messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Omeprazole can cause kidney problems.
Tell your doctor if you are urinating less than usual, or if you have blood in your urine.
Diarrhea may be a sign of a new infection.
Call your doctor right away if you have watery stools or stomach pain that does not go away.
You may or may not have a fever.
Omeprazole is not to be used for the immediate relief of heartburn symptoms.
Omeprazole may cause new or worsening symptoms of lupus.
Tell your doctor if you have joint pain and a skin rash on your cheeks or arms that worsens in sunlight.
You may be more likely to have a broken bone while taking Omeprazole long term or more than once per day.
Triplet: ["omeprazole", "not indicated for", "immediate relief of heartburn symptoms"]

The relation 'not indicated for' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug is not intended or recommended for the medical condition or purpose specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'not approved for': The subject drug is not approved or not recommended for use in the patient population specified by the object entity.
B. 'not used for': The subject drug is not indicated or used for the condition, situation, or purpose specified by the object entity.
C. 'not a substitute for': The subject drug should not be used in place of the medical device or medication specified by the object entity.
D. 'not chemically related to': The subject drug is not chemically similar to or related to the substance specified by the object entity.
E. 'contraindicated in': The subject drug should not be used by patients who have the condition or characteristic specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
